page_title: AUS 2-0 TUR | Australia v Turkey 14/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jesus Valenzuela has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Turkey take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Arda Guler (Turkey), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+5' Turkey take a short corner kick.
90+4' Aziz Behich (Australia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' The Turkey players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+1' Merih Demiral (Turkey) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Dangerous play by Tete Yengi (Australia). Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.

89' Arda Guler (Turkey) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Patrick Beach pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
86' Yunus Akgun (Turkey) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
86' Hakan Calhanoglu (Turkey) almost scores with a cheeky low shot towards goal that goes under the defensive wall, but Patrick Beach is alert and makes a good save.

85' Tete Yengi (Australia) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jackson Irvine (Australia) replaces Paul Okon-Engstler.
84' Tony Popovic has decided to substitute Jordan Bos and he is replaced by Aziz Behich (Australia).
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ferdi Kadioglu (Turkey).
82' Arda Guler (Turkey) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
81' Mert Muldur (Turkey) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Zeki Celik.
81' Here is a change. Ismail Yuksek is going off and Vincenzo Montella gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Turkey).
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Australia comes to nothing.
79' Connor Metcalfe (Australia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
78' Tete Yengi (Australia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Valenzuela blows for a foul.
78' Kerem Akturkoglu (Turkey) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
77' Kenan Yildiz (Turkey) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

75' 2 - 0 Goal! Connor Metcalfe (Australia) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Ugurcan Cakir had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
74' Tony Popovic has decided to make a change. Tete Yengi (Australia) replaces Mohamed Toure.
74' Substitution. Jacob Italiano walks off the pitch and Jason Geria (Australia) comes on as a substitute.
74' Arda Guler (Turkey) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
73' Arda Guler (Turkey) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
72' Great save! Zeki Celik (Turkey) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Patrick Beach.
72' Kenan Yildiz (Turkey) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
68' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!

66' Kenan Yildiz (Turkey) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

65' Arda Guler (Turkey) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
63' Kenan Yildiz (Turkey) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

60' A pass by Arda Guler (Turkey) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

57' A dangerous looking corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Turkey) is cleared to safety by the defence.

53' The referee blows his whistle, Australia are awarded a corner kick.

46' Hakan Calhanoglu (Turkey) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the middle of the goal, but Patrick Beach reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
46' Vincenzo Montella has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kenan Yildiz (Turkey) comes on the pitch for Baris Yilmaz.

38' Great teamplay by Australia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

27' 1 - 0 Nestory Irankunda (Australia) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
